central_register_due.description: The day ACRA's central register is due: 2 business days after the company's, weekends left out (public holidays are not, so it is never later than the law's) [verify].

company_register_due.description: The day the company's register is due: 7 days after they became one.

notice_due.description: A registered controller's yearly notice: due a year after the last one sent, or after they were entered.

ownership.description: Their percentage of the shares issued today (RND-DISPLAY).

rights.description: Their recorded rights could confer control (a board majority, consent matters): a person weighs them.

shares.description: More than 25% of the shares issued.

since.description: The first day of their latest run over 25%.

standing.description: to_enter: not yet in the company's register; to_lodge: entered, ACRA's central register not updated; registered: both; not_assessed: rights to weigh and no conclusion recorded; not_a_controller: concluded not to be one.

voting.description: Their percentage of the votes today.
